name: Remi Svensson
source:
Massage Style: Swedish
Likes: Accessories, Rald, clothes
Dislikes: Sota, noisy people, shallow people

(Kickstarter)
A half-Swedish masseur who also works as a model. He has a very calm disposition and takes his massages too seriously sometimes. He doesn't like talking as much and thinks before acting. He seems to have a liking for men but he's not entirely sure of it yet. He has an icy and cold disposition which contrasts with his appearances on TV.

A part-time masseur at Full Service Spa, he also works as a model during the day. While having a handsome face, he also has an irritable personality. He can be rather opinionated about things, and often times finds joy in teasing Tomoki. He seems to have reservations about something, as his mask slips from time to time.

(Facebook)
Known as the Icy Cold Prince thanks to his attitude towards people. He is in denial and having sexual identity issues, not being able to admit his liking to men. Working in Full Service Spa just to get compliments or admiration for himself.

His days are mostly used for dating different girls, but somehow always ends up with failure.
